title: CONTINENTAL LAKE WATER TEMPERATURE
freshness: LATEST AVAILABLE (daily analyses; blended typically ~3-day latency, MUR typically ~2-day latency)
noaa_source: JPL GHRSST Level 4 MUR Global Foundation SST Analysis v4.1 (analysed_sst, degree_C; 1 km daily) (lakes) + NOAA CoastWatch Geo-Polar Blended SST Analysis, Diurnal Correction (Day+Night), GHRSST NRT Global 5 km Daily (analysed_sst, degree_C) (oceans/seas) + NOAA/GLERL CoastWatch GLSEA (Great Lakes Surface Environmental Analysis) (Great Lakes)
product_name: JPL GHRSST Level 4 MUR Global Foundation SST Analysis v4.1 (analysed_sst, degree_C; 1 km daily) (lakes) + NOAA CoastWatch Geo-Polar Blended SST Analysis, Diurnal Correction (Day+Night), GHRSST NRT Global 5 km Daily (analysed_sst, degree_C) (oceans/seas) + NOAA/GLERL CoastWatch GLSEA (Great Lakes Surface Environmental Analysis) (Great Lakes)
variable: analysed/fused lake surface + sea surface water temperature (satellite-derived composite/analysis)
spatial_resolution_source: blended 0.05 deg analysis resampled to 0.10 deg global canvas (+ GLSEA ~1.8 km inside the Great Lakes rectangle)
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: non-water mask cells, fill values, out-of-range values and Great Lakes-rectangle blended cells (GLSEA wins there) rendered fully transparent; never interpolated, never zero-filled.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.

na_bounds.note: Authoritative common geography for the GLOBAL coverage variant of the four live gradients (wind_na, precipitation_na, cloud_cover_na, air_temperature_na). Same 0.10 deg/px grid as aurora_global. Basin + North America variants keep their existing canvases; only the former extended200 variant moves here. Areas without valid source data stay transparent.

legend_scale_html: Surface water temperature (°F) — Continental Lake Coverage: cold 32°F (deep blue) → 57.5°F → warm 83°F (red). Mean this run: 56.2°F. White halo numbers are actual °F at that spot. Endpoints are recomputed every run from this coverage's own tracked inland-lake water only (MUR open-lake cells plus Great Lakes GLSEA cells; 1st/99th percentiles, clamped 32–86°F, linear mapping between them). Ocean water is excluded from this distribution, so the same color stands for a different °F than in the other coverages — only the printed numbers are absolute. Lakes below the fetch sampling, frozen lakes outside the open-lake mask state, and rivers stay transparent and are never fabricated.
